seg.notes: Segment sales from the Q4 release. eps_bridge_lines: Faiveley transaction expenses (~$26m), contract adjustments & restructuring (~$15m), debt refinancing / pre-closing interest (~$22m), Faiveley tax items (net benefit ~$18m) and $9m Faiveley non-controlling interest expense - combined effect as stated

items.other_label: other_op = 'expenses of about $15 million primarily for contract adjustments and restructuring' (release, not split); nonop = $22m of debt refinancing expenses and additional interest costs incurred prior to closing Faiveley; discrete_tax = -(27 income from French statutory rate change on deferred tax liability) + 9 (non-deductibility of certain transaction costs) = -18 (removing a net benefit)

ngaap.guidance: 2017 guidance: revenues about $4.1 billion; adjusted diluted EPS $3.95-$4.15 excluding expected restructuring and transaction charges and Faiveley-related non-controlling interest expense; Q1-17 adjusted EPS similar to Q4-16 adjusted EPS, H2 stronger than H1; 2017 effective tax rate about 29.5%; Faiveley synergies about $15-20 million in 2017, long-term > $50 million.
ngaap.notes: No reconciliation table or EBITDA reconciliation published in the release (2015-2016 releases contain only the GAAP income statement and segment sales). Release narrative (no table): all items reduced Q4 net income by $27 million; items plus $9m Faiveley NCI expense reduced diluted EPS by 39 cents. Adjusted EPS / adjusted NI not explicitly published; implied adjusted diluted EPS = 0.42 + 0.39 = $0.81 and implied adjusted op income = 62.8 + 26 + 15 = ~$103.8m (computed, not published). tax_effect on pre-tax items not published (implied ~ -18: 63 pre-tax items - 18 net discrete tax benefit - 27 NI effect).
